title.zh: 给整列读数设一道门槛
title.en: Set a Cutoff for a Whole Column

brief.zh: 调一调温度条件。哪几行被 NumPy 掩码保留下来？
brief.en: Change the temperature condition. Which rows does the NumPy mask keep?

concept.zh: 用一次比较生成掩码，再根据掩码选出记录。
concept.en: Create a mask with one comparison and use it to select records.

hints.zh: 把条件从至少 24 °C 切换成至多 24 °C，留意 24 °C 的记录。
hints.en: Switch from at least 24 °C to at most 24 °C and watch the readings of exactly 24 °C.

prompt.zh: 改变比较方向或门槛，观察等于门槛的读数是否留下。
prompt.en: Change the comparison or cutoff and watch whether readings equal to the cutoff stay.
